name: dsh-tui-vscode
description: Run dsh-TUI in a dedicated VS Code panel with a real PTY (Claude Code style): activity-bar entry, xterm.js rendering, file links, $VISUAL/$EDITOR via code -w.

commands.title: dsh-tui: Open panel / 打开会话面板
dsh-tui: Start new session / 启动新会话
dsh-tui: Resume last session / 恢复上次会话
dsh-tui: Focus session panel / 聚焦会话面板
dsh-tui: Terminate session / 终止会话

dsh-tui-vscode.command.description: Command / executable that launches dsh-TUI. On Windows this is resolved through PATH (dsh-tui.cmd), or set it to an absolute path.

dsh-tui-vscode.extraArgs.description: Extra CLI arguments appended to every dsh-tui launch, e.g. ["--lang", "en"].

enumDescriptions: Do not set DSH_TUI_LANG; dsh-tui uses its own default (Chinese).
dsh-tui-vscode.lang.description: Sets DSH_TUI_LANG for the dsh-tui process.

dsh-tui-vscode.injectEditor.description: When $VISUAL/$EDITOR are unset, export VISUAL=<editorCommand> so the TUI's Ctrl+X external editor opens in VS Code.

dsh-tui-vscode.editorCommand.description: Value exported as $VISUAL when dsh-tui-vscode.injectEditor is on and no VISUAL/EDITOR exists. Use the VS Code CLI with -w to wait for the file to close.

dsh-tui-vscode.dshHome.description: Optional $DSH_HOME override for the dsh-tui session ('' keeps the value inherited from the VS Code process).

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/session.test.js out/test/links.test.js out/test/paths.test.js out/test/osc.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test-suite/run-tests.js
scripts.package: npm run build:webview && npm run compile && vsce package
